problem_type: Unbounded notification action consumes message width
symptom: Chinese notification body wraps to one glyph per line at 360px.
direct_cause: ToastMessage action has shrink-0 without a width cap; flex-1 min-w-0 body absorbs all compression.
class_root: Shared notification content lacks a sibling width budget and readable minimum geometry.
affected_population: Any toast caller with long localized or dynamic action labels
internal_only_reason: Application CSS width allocation, not a dependency API defect; installed Mantine notification rendering is exercised unchanged.
invariants: Action width <=40% of content row; full accessible label and title survive truncation.
Notification has viewport-safe minimum width; text remains readable.
generality_proof: Every toast caller passes through ToastMessage; geometry depends on available space, not provider or input length.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Allocate readable message width and bounded action width for all inputs.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Pushes localized undo labels through useToastStore.
Retry failed-count action uses the same toast store.
Camera-name action can be arbitrarily long and uses the same toast store.

recurrence.reason: Any localized or user-derived action can repeat the failure.
same_class_scan: AST scan of all src/electron TSX flex rows with min-w-0 flex-1 body and unbounded shrink-0 siblings; 89 candidates (105 raw output lines) recorded in scan report.
rg actionLabel and useToastStore locates undo, batch retry and scene camera callers.

prevention.invariant: The action never consumes more than 40% of row width.
prevention.failure_mode: Overlong labels truncate visually while full label remains in title and accessible name.
prevention.strategy: Constrain the shared component rather than individual labels or callers.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replaces the unbounded action class in place; no parallel host.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No framework change; application owns CSS geometry. Real installed Mantine is retained and rendered in browser regression.

migration: No persisted state changes or migration.
residual_risks: B4 switch-action producer is an uncommitted change in Nomi-money-guard, absent from origin/main. Display-name patch is prepared but not applied or tested.
Non-toast homologous layout risks are enumerated in the report; browser verification covers the shared toast only.
